MDG.note: Names no AI rule, draft or authority; the CMIL cycle only 'should lead' to a first regulation.
States AI is a reality in justice practice but names no system, body or pilot.
A first AI regulation for justice is only an expected outcome of a conference cycle; no draft is named.
Says AI is already a reality in justice practice but names no tool or output.

facts.fact: Madagascar's Justice Ministry secretary general says tools including InfoTA, InfoTF, LogiComm, LogiCivil and LogiPenal are already deployed in the courts.
